title: Select active users
description: Return the names of active users.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name TEXT, active INTEGER)
expected_query: SELECT name FROM users WHERE active = 1;

title: Order users by name
description: Return all user names in ascending alphabetical order.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name TEXT)
expected_query: SELECT name FROM users ORDER BY name ASC;

title: Count users by status
description: Return each active status and the number of users in that status.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, active INTEGER)
expected_query: SELECT active, COUNT(*) FROM users GROUP BY active;
